name: custom-field
description: Field not in formatted output (reporter, labels, parent) → agent should use `jira --json get | jq` one-liner.
prompt: Kdo je reporter ticketu KNW-31435 a jaké má labels?
expected_behaviors: extracts both fields in a single bash invocation (one API call)
outputs only the requested values (reporter name + labels)
anti_patterns: makes two separate `jira --json get` calls for the two fields
dumps the full JSON response to the user
tries to use `jira get` and complains the data is missing
